key_sections.abstract:
Hydrothermal reaction of ZnSO4·7H2O and 3-amino-1H-1, 2, 4-triazole (HATRZ) led 
to a three-dimensional zinc(II) coordination polymer, Zn2(ATRZ)2SO4·3H2O (1).
key_sections.conclusion:
